title: Decision framing & AI strategy

title: Gerry’s dnata — Customer Support & Tariff Intelligence

Tariff and quotation queries arrived through several channels, while the answers lived across rate sheets, documents and individual expertise. Response time and consistency depended on who was available.

title: Genix — Cleanroom Environmental Monitoring
text: Enterprise project. A monitoring application for Genix pharmaceutical cleanrooms, connecting environmental telemetry with an operational web interface. Cleanroom teams need environmental readings in a form they can inspect while managing daily operations. This project connects monitoring data from Genix pharmaceutical cleanrooms to a web interface designed around that work.

title: Banking & Finance
text: Banks and financial institutions operate across high-volume interactions, complex risk signals and strict data obligations. Nyrix helps teams turn customer, contact-centre and operational data into governed intelligence that supports faster, more confident decisions. Customer intelligence, contact-centre intelligence and private AI decision support.

title: Food & Beverage
text: F&B operators balance demand volatility, stock availability, promotion effectiveness and customer preference across locations and channels. Nyrix connects those signals so teams can plan with greater clarity and act before margin or service levels are affected. Demand, stock, audience and promotion decisions across locations and channels.

title: Insurance
text: Insurance decisions depend on timing, trust and context. Nyrix helps insurers connect customer behaviour, service conversations and portfolio signals to understand who needs attention, what action is most useful and where value is being lost. Customer segmentation, lifetime value, retention and next-best action.

title: Legal
text: Legal teams work across documents, precedent, deadlines and decisions where accuracy, traceability and human accountability matter. Nyrix can help structure knowledge workflows and decision support without treating automation as a substitute for professional judgement. Knowledge workflows, document intelligence and accountable decision support.

title: Media & Advertising
text: Media and advertising organisations need to connect audience behaviour, campaign performance and commercial opportunity across fast-moving channels. Nyrix turns fragmented signals into practical intelligence for planning, targeting and optimisation. Audience signals, campaign performance and marketing opportunity intelligence.

title: Travel & Hospitality
text: Travel and hospitality organisations coordinate customer service, pricing, capacity, movement and operational delivery in real time. Nyrix connects those signals to help teams respond with more consistency and foresight. Customer support, tariff intelligence, demand signals and operational visibility.

title: Pharmaceutical
text: Pharmaceutical organisations manage planning, supply, evidence and operational decisions where traceability and control are essential. Nyrix supports applied AI initiatives that fit existing workflows and remain accountable to the people responsible for the outcome. Planning, operational monitoring and governed applied AI for complex workflows.
